programme.desc: S02 E02 — The Charity Shop Poltergeist Facing a destructive spirit that has been menacing charity shop manager Sybil and her co-workers; dig in with Danny, who discovers a hidden room, clues about this entity's identity and possible links to something called the "stone tape theory."
programme.title: Uncanny

programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: The Mother and Daughter Killers Learn how influencer Mahek Bukhari and her mom, Ansreen, became the UK's first mother and daughter convicted of a double murder; see how the pair hatched a deadly plot when Hashim Ijazuddin tried to blackmail his much older ex-lover, Ansreen.
programme.title: Tik tok: murder gone viral

programme.title: A Secret to Die For

One of the smallest houses the team has taken on offers up big challenges: with a family stuck in a tiny home, unable to deal with their grief, the team along with generous West Bromwich volunteers step in to drastically improve this family's home.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Mastermind to Murder Piers travels to Gatesville, Texas, to meet Erin Caffey who, at the age of 16, masterminded the brutal murder of her entire family. For this incomprehensible act, Erin will remain behind bars until she is almost 60 years old. Piers learns from Erin what made a typical teenage girl conspire with her boyfriend to kill her mum, dad and two younger brothers. Afterwards, Piers drives to rural East Texas to meet the one survivor of the tragedy: Erin's father Terry, who has made the choice to forgive.
programme.title: Killer Women with Piers Morgan

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Episode 2 Piers meets two very different women, both of whom killed someone they loved. Amanda Lewis is serving a life sentence for killing her seven-year-old daughter, and former beauty queen Rhonda Glover gunned down her lover in cold blood.
programme.title: Killer Women with Piers Morgan

programme.desc: S7 E7 — Abi Ever After It's the day before Roger and Abi's wedding, but for this accident-prone couple, anything that can go wrong probably will, before the marriage is solemnized.
programme.title: My Family

programme.desc: S2 E3 — The Viney Family Stacey and her gang challenge the Viney family to sort their lives out by decluttering in just seven days. Not only did grandma of six Sue fill her house up with her late mum's belongings, she also acquired the contents of a recently closed gift shop. Daughters Nicki and Donna want to spend more time at the house with their kids, but all the clutter means there isn't any space.
programme.title: Sort Your Life Out
